question: How do the in-season award odds (NBA, NFL, NHL, CFB) compare with traded prices?
answer: The market is far ahead: winner log loss 2.34 (model) vs 1.22 (Polymarket) on the 2025-26 races.
findings: Held 2025-26: 19 race-checkpoints, 10 races. Model 2.345, market 1.218; market better in 7 of 10 (t 2.44).
A temperature fit to the market (T 1.5) did not help on outcomes: held change -.07 (t -.53).
CFB first backtest (2005-25, 246 checkpoints): favourite .33/.37/.42 vs hit rate .11/.24/.31 at 25/50/75%.
method: As-of races rebuilt at 25/50/75% of each season with leave-one-season-out voter fits (scripts/awards_asof.py). Market = Polymarket (global) daily price of the eventual winner on the day after the checkpoint, renormalised over listed candidates; checkpoints whose prices sum more than 25% off 1 are dropped as illiquid.
data: scripts/data/poly_hist (36 closed events, 2024-26); nflverse, in-repo NBA boxes, sportsdataverse ESPN CFB boxes.
split_check: Market ahead in both seasons (2024-25 and 2025-26).
